svg.title: Manage commands and keyboard shortcuts
svg.desc: The Commands and shortcuts page as Obsidian draws it reads two example saved commands through the actual CustomCommandManager. Obsidian's fixture reports no assigned hotkeys, so the real shortcut chips read Blank; the built-in commands keep their production switches.

text.font-family: "??", "??", "??", ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, "system-ui", system-ui, "Segoe UI", "Google Sans Flex", Roboto, "Inter Variable", Inter, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", sans-serif

g.text: Press ⊕ on a command to set its shortcut in Obsidian's hotkey settings.
